mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.name AS userName, u.number AS studentNo, p.id AS paperId, p.paper_name AS paperName, c.id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, ar.user_score AS userScore, ar.total_score AS totalScore, ar.create_time AS examTime FROM answer_record ar LEFT JOIN user u ON ar.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN paper p ON ar.paper_id = p.id LEFT JOIN courses c ON p.course_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{courseId} ORDER BY ar.create_time DESC

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.name AS userName, u.number AS studentNo, p.id AS paperId, p.paper_name AS paperName, c.id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, ar.user_score AS userScore, ar.total_score AS totalScore, ar.create_time AS examTime FROM answer_record ar LEFT JOIN user u ON ar.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN paper p ON ar.paper_id = p.id LEFT JOIN courses c ON p.course_id = c.id WHERE ar.user_id = #{userId} AND c.id = #{courseId} ORDER BY ar.create_time DESC
